models_evaluated: Epic In Basket Augmented Response Technology (ART)

links.outcome: After-hours message response burden and turnaround time with AI draft tool use
links.effect: Tool use not associated with overall after-hours reduction (0.61 pp, 95% CI -1.02 to 2.24); fewer after-hours replies for test-result queries received in working hours (-3.67 pp) but more for messages received after hours (+4.52 pp).
links.quote: Response tool use was not associated with an overall reduction of after-hours messaging burden (0.61 [95% CI, -1.02 to 2.24] percentage points; P = .46).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of Epic's AI-generated draft response tool on clinician message turnaround time and after-hours replies, but does not compare or evaluate a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
